resources.string: Migrely is a headache diary. It helps you keep a record of your migraines, the medications you take and what might set them off, so you can see patterns and talk them over with your doctor.
Migrely is not a medical device. It doesn\'t diagnose, treat or prevent any condition, and nothing in it is medical advice. Its counts and patterns come only from what you logged.
Talk to a doctor about your headaches, and before you start, stop or change a medication.
If a headache comes with any of the warning signs, call your local emergency number.
Migrely has no internet access, so it sends nothing anywhere. There\'s no account to make and nothing to sign in to.
Your entries stay on this phone. On Android 9 and later, Android\'s own backup keeps a copy in your Google account only when it can encrypt it end to end, which needs a screen lock.
A file leaves the phone only when you export it yourself: a backup, a spreadsheet or a report for your doctor.
Delete all data, at the end of Settings, removes everything Migrely keeps on this phone.
